name: VDB LeafNode Structure
definition: The lowest-level block of the VDB grid, residing at the same tree depth. It tiles index space into nonoverlapping subdomains with $2^{	ext{Log}2w}$ voxels along each coordinate axis.
summary: The VDB LeafNode is the lowest-level VDB grid block that stores voxel data and embeds its global origin in flags, eliminating parent references to minimize memory overhead.
